membershipPage.subtitle: [TODO-TRANSLATE] Join Buhary Janaza Welfare Society as a registered member to support communal welfare, receive funeral aid, and strengthen brotherhood.
membershipPage.overviewText: [TODO-TRANSLATE] Registered membership is open to resident Muslim families and individuals of the Buhary Jummah Mosque area in Mullipothanai. Members pool small monthly or annual welfare subscriptions that ensure round-the-clock funeral assistance and emergency relief for every member family.
membershipPage.planMonthlyDesc: [TODO-TRANSLATE] Standard family welfare contribution, collected through designated Mahallah area collectors or direct bank transfer.
membershipPage.planAnnualDesc: [TODO-TRANSLATE] One-time yearly settlement supporting sustained cemetery maintenance and operational logistics.
membershipPage.criteria1: [TODO-TRANSLATE] Open to all Muslim families residing within the Buhary Jummah Mosque Mahallah, Mullipothanai.
membershipPage.criteria2: [TODO-TRANSLATE] Commitment to mutual social support, communal solidarity, and respectful cooperation.
membershipPage.criteria3: [TODO-TRANSLATE] Active involvement in voluntary shramadhana cemetery cleanups and community welfare initiatives.

reportsPage.subtitle: [TODO-TRANSLATE] We uphold transparent, accountable governance with annual audited financial statements and regular community activity reports.
reportsPage.transparencyBody: [TODO-TRANSLATE] As a registered community welfare society (Reg: DS/TH/SS/VSSO/2023/01), all donations, monthly subscriptions, and project expenditures are meticulously audited by community-nominated auditors, approved by the general assembly, and submitted annually to the Divisional Secretariat.

privacyPage.subtitle: [TODO-TRANSLATE] How Buhary Janaza Welfare Society collects, safeguards, and uses information provided by community members.
privacyPage.section1Body: [TODO-TRANSLATE] Buhary Janaza Welfare Society collects personal information strictly for genuine welfare services, including funeral coordination, membership directory records, subscription tracking, and emergency communications. We collect only what is strictly necessary: names, contact phone numbers, residential areas, and household sizes.
privacyPage.section2Body: [TODO-TRANSLATE] We respect your dignity and privacy. Personal details submitted via this website are never sold, traded, or shared with commercial entities or unauthorized third parties. Access to member records is restricted strictly to authorized executive committee officers (President, Secretary, and Treasurer).
privacyPage.section3Body: [TODO-TRANSLATE] Photographs published on this website document public community activities (e.g. shramadhana cleanups, humanitarian distributions). In accordance with society guidelines, photos highlighting identifiable community members, women, or minors require explicit consent and administrative verification prior to publication.
privacyPage.section4Body: [TODO-TRANSLATE] You have the right to request access to your submitted details, request corrections, or request removal from our contact lists. For any inquiries regarding data protection, please contact the society secretary at mbjwsociety@gmail.com or visit the society office at the 95th Buhary Jummah Mosque, Mullipothanai.
